title: Card menu
summary: The "..." (or settings) button of a card header that opens a menu of secondary actions. A pk-dropdown opened by an icon-only button, so the keyboard, the focus return and the placement are the dropdown's; put it in the actions slot of a pk-card with pk-menu-item children.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the button, which is also its tooltip. Name what the menu acts on when a page has several ("Orders actions").

props.name: iconName
props.description: The icon of the button: more (the default), settings, or any other name of the icon sprite.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side the menu opens on. The default aligns it with the button at the end of the header.

slots.description: pk-menu-item children (give each a value to tell them apart in pk-select, or an href).

events.name: pk-select
events.description: An item was chosen (the pk-dropdown's event, which reaches this element).

parts.name: button
parts.description: The icon pk-button that opens it.

a11y: The button is named by label and carries aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded (set by the pk-dropdown); Enter, Space and ArrowDown open it, arrows, Home, End and typeahead move between items, Escape or choosing an item closes it and returns focus to the button.
mobile: The button is a touch-sized target on a phone and the menu stays inside the viewport (the pk-dropdown shifts it).
